bannerAndroid: Open your recipes faster and use the shopping list like an app.
bannerIos: On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
title: Install Preppr on your phone
intro: Once installed, Preppr opens like an app and the shopping list stays usable offline (based on what your browser has already cached).
androidBody: Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right, then choose Install app or Add to Home screen (depending on the version).
androidCaption: Diagram of the Chrome menu on Android with the install-app option
iosBody: Tap the Share button, scroll if needed, then Add to Home Screen.
iosCaption: Diagram of Safari on iPhone with the Share button and Add to Home Screen
httpsHint: If you do not see an install prompt, check that you open the site over HTTPS and that you are using Chrome (Android) or Safari (iOS).
